questions.q: To start, could you briefly introduce yourself and the kind of work you've been doing recently?
In your InsightAI project, what specific problem did you solve with hybrid retrieval?
expected: Explain why they combined keyword and vector search for better coverage.
Describe how they checked retrieval quality or handled irrelevant results.
Mention the trade-offs between speed and accuracy in their design.

questions.q: For your SLA-Triage system, how did you handle data preprocessing before training the model?
expected: Detail specific steps like handling missing values or feature scaling.
Explain why they chose XGBoost over other models for this task.
Describe how they validated the pipeline's performance with simulations.

questions.q: How do you decide which hyperparameters to tune when training a model for prediction?
expected: Discuss strategies like grid search or random search with cross-validation.
Explain how they balance model complexity against overfitting risks.
Mention tools like Aim used to track these experiments effectively.

questions.q: Explain how cross-validation helps prevent overfitting during model evaluation.
expected: Describe splitting data into folds for robust performance estimation.
Clarify why it matters more than a single train-test split for small datasets.
Mention how it guides decisions on model complexity or feature selection.

questions.q: When building a RAG pipeline, what factors influence your choice of embedding model?
expected: Consider data domain specificity and computational resource constraints.
Discuss latency requirements versus semantic search accuracy needs.
Explain how they validate embeddings against real-world query performance.
